top_findings.title: head_to_head double-counts fixtures duplicated across source CSVs
top_findings.evidence: src/brazilian_soccer_mcp/core.clj:170 filters (:matches (data)) directly and never calls dedupe-matches, unlike find-matches (core.clj:151). Flamengo-Palmeiras 2019 appears twice in each of Brasileirao_Matches.csv, novo_campeonato_brasileiro.csv (both map to :competition brasileirao) and BR-Football-Dataset.csv, so a two-team H2H sums each fixture 2-3x. The H2H test only uses a 2-match in-memory fixture.
top_findings.suggestion: Pipe games through dedupe-matches before reducing, or build head-to-head on top of find-matches.
